card.name: Inside bpm and MPM abbreviations
card.fires_on: The second piece of a short abbreviation, mostly the 'pm' in 'bpm' right after 'beats per minute (b'. It also fires on 'PM' or 'WP' after 'M' in acronyms like MPM and MWP.

modes.label: bpm after beats per minute
modes.description: The 'pm' that completes the abbreviation bpm in parentheses after a heart rate figure.
modes.example: increased pulse rate exceeding 100 beats per minute (b<<pm>>) (3 of 6 subjects).

modes.label: Acronyms starting with M
modes.description: The closing letters of an acronym that begins with M, such as MPM or MWP.
modes.example: Adult patients with NSCLC, M<<PM>>, HNSCC, HER2-negative
